column1: # Seasoning: sauces and condiments, pastes, vinegars.
# Columns, tab-separated: id, labelRu, labelEn, parentId, divisible, factors, removed, synonymsRu, synonymsEn, nutrition, nutritionSource (dictionary/README.md).
# Soy sauce and Asian sauces and pastes (8000-8099). ml is density; spoons are level.
# соевый соус сладкий → none: thickened with sugar, far sweeter than soy sauce; no source holds it
# соус арахисовый → fdc:174070 peanut sauce made from peanut butter, water and soy sauce
# имбирь маринованный → fdc:169765 pickled ginger (sweetened with an artificial sweetener in USDA's sample)
# Tomato products and table sauces (8100-8199).
# пассата → fdc:170460 canned tomato puree: sieved tomatoes of about the same solids
# соус краснодарский → Skurikhin «Соус томатный острый»: a canned tomato table sauce of the same kind (Skurikhin 8.1.6.13, p. 144-145)
# соус шашлычный → Skurikhin «Соус томатный острый»: a canned tomato table sauce of the same kind (Skurikhin 8.1.6.13, p. 144-145)
# майонез → Skurikhin «Майонез «Провансаль»»: the 67% mayonnaise Russian shops sell (Skurikhin 5.8.1, p. 108-109)
# майонез лёгкий → fdc:168094 reduced-calorie mayonnaise (about a third fat, like the Russian light kinds)
# айоли → fdc:171009 regular mayonnaise: aioli is a garlic oil-and-egg emulsion of the same kind
# соус бешамель → fdc:174525 homemade medium white sauce
# заправка для салата → Skurikhin «Заправка для салата»: the oil-and-vinegar dressing (Skurikhin 12.2.13, p. 192-193)
# соус брусничный → fdc:173961 sweetened canned cranberry sauce: lingonberry sauce is made the same way from a close berry
# Mustard, horseradish, Caucasian sauces, pesto, spreads and pastes (8200-8299).
# горчица → Skurikhin «Горчица столовая»: the hot table mustard a Russian cook means (Skurikhin 12.2.15, p. 192-193)
# горчица медовая → none: sweetened with honey, not plain mustard; no source holds it
# горчица баварская → none: a sweet mustard, not plain mustard; no source holds it
# песто → fdc:171580 ready-to-serve shelf-stable pesto: the jarred kind
# паста из фундука → fdc:170583 dry-roasted hazelnuts: hazelnut butter is ground roasted nuts
# фисташковая паста → fdc:170184 raw pistachios: pistachio paste is ground nuts
# кокосовая паста → fdc:168585 creamed desiccated coconut meat
# уксус → fdc:172237 distilled vinegar: what уксус means without a kind
# уксус столовый 9% → none: about twice the acid of the 5 % vinegar its parent cites; no source holds it
# уксусная эссенция → none: 70 % acid, about fourteen times the 5 % vinegar its parent cites; no source holds it
# уксус бальзамический белый → fdc:172241 balsamic vinegar: white balsamic is sweet grape must with vinegar too
